goal: Local and private deployments persist board records in SQLite and store uploaded files on the workspace filesystem with database metadata
scenarios: opening a workspace with existing JSON board data loads that data from database tables
later board writes survive process restart without depending on board.json as the source of truth
an upload is stored under the workspace storage root with filename, MIME type, size, hash, uploader, project, and path recorded
an oversize or disallowed file type is rejected
large file bytes are not stored inside the database
constraints: upper layers use one internal database service rather than a concrete driver
the file backend can be replaced later without requiring MinIO
nonGoals: hosted GitHub, Gitea, or GitLab adapters
